resources.string: Allow access to files so the game can read its files in Download/Diablo3Mobile. Tap here, allow access, then return.
Game files were not found in Download/Diablo3Mobile. On a PC, run setup with your own game files, then copy the \"Diablo3Mobile\" folder it makes to the phone\'s Download folder.
The patched game modules are missing (Download/Diablo3Mobile/dm/out). Run setup on the PC again and copy the whole \"Diablo3Mobile\" folder to the phone\'s Download folder again.
The shaders are missing (Download/Diablo3Mobile/dm/shaders). Run setup on the PC again and copy the whole \"Diablo3Mobile\" folder to the phone\'s Download folder again.
